name: Chicken Wings with Broccoli, Radish, Date, Feta & Mint Salad

ingredients.name: chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 500°F. Coat a large baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.

Pat chicken wings dry with paper towels and place in a medium bowl. Sprinkle with cornstarch and spices, then toss to coat. Transfer to the baking sheet, spread out in an even layer, and drizzle with additional oil.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed
4 tsp cornstarch
garlic powder
salt
black pepper
extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Place wings in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until cooked through, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 crowns broccoli
1 lemon
1 small pkg fresh mint
1 bunch radish

instructions.primary_message: Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add broccoli and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until broccoli is tender-crisp, 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
garlic powder
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the broccoli is cooking, roughly chop dates.
When the broccoli is done, add dates and sesame seeds to the skillet, then stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until dates have softened, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, zest and juice lemon into a clean medium bowl. Add oil and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp cumin, ground
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and slice radishes crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl.
Peel, halve, and slice shallot lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl, along with feta and cooked broccoli, then toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 shallot
1 (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide wings and salad between plates. Enjoy!
